svg.title: Ivan Harvey Rivera
svg.desc: Ivan Harvey Rivera, Junior Full-Stack Developer. Modern web apps and LLM-powered solutions. Stack: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Next.js, Vite, Svelte, Node.js, Express, FastAPI, Python, PHP, SQLite, Drizzle ORM. Certificates: IBM Full-Stack Software Developer Professional Certificate (Coursera, Jul 2026); ASEAN AI Hackathon 2026 Certificate (Passage to ASEAN, Jun 2026); National Innovation Day Hackathon (DEVCON Philippines, Apr 2025); National Innovation Day Hackathon: Unboxing the Filipino Mindset (Synetcom Philippines, Apr 2024). Bonus: GitHub Pull Shark x2, Starstruck x2, YOLO. Tabs open: enough to heat the CPU. Sleep schedule: currently in beta.
